new_upstream_change.summary: skip re-ingesting accepted draft tokens whose KV lookahead already wrote
design_constraints: committed draft KV is scheduler managed
speculative KV reuse requires matching committed token identity
speculative KV reuse requires unchanged physical block lineage
rejection, scratch placement, reallocation, and stale state fail closed
the final committed row remains executable so the next draft can be produced

new_rebase_acceptance: validate token identity and physical block lineage before speculative KV reuse
fail closed on rejection, scratch placement, reallocation, preemption, cancellation, and request-id reuse
never skip the final committed row required to generate the next draft
include Qwen MTP cache groups and auxiliary state in scheduler and worker memory budgets
